profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc. is a public company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, trading under the ticker EFX with SEC CIK number 0000033185. Its website describes the company as a credit bureau that provides credit reports and credit scores for businesses and consumers. It also offers identity protection tools with daily monitoring and alerts, including a product called Equifax Complete.

The site describes ID Restoration Specialists who work on behalf of victims of identity theft, and it provides educational content on credit reports, credit scores, debt, credit cards, loans, and personal finance, with some material available in Spanish. The company's own text does not mention artificial intelligence products.

Public records associated with Equifax list 105 law exposure entries in Georgia. No additional product or litigation details are present in the available data.
